task_instance: Build a Great Expectations data quality validation suite for a sample 'orders' dataset covering the completeness, uniqueness and validity dimensions from the skill, and run it over the data to produce pass/fail results per expectation.
evidence: Created a Python virtualenv in the work directory and installed great_expectations 1.24.1 (pip -q). Wrote orders.csv (7 rows) with deliberate quality defects. Wrote validate_orders.py using the skill's Quick Start modern GX API (gx.expectations.ExpectColumnValuesToNotBeNull/ToBeUnique/ToBeInSet/ToBeBetween) across completeness, uniqueness and validity dimensions. Ran: python validate_orders.py. The suite executed and correctly reported OVERALL SUCCESS: False, detecting each seeded defect: order_id not-null success=True(0); order_id unique success=False(2 duplicates); customer_id not-null success=False(1 missing); status in-set success=False(1 invalid value); amount >0 and <=100000 success=False(2 violations). Deliverable verified by matching detected counts to the known defects in the sample. Files: validate_orders.py, orders.csv, result.json in the work directory.
